taste.name: Memory before coordinates
taste.trigger: When a listening event includes a recollection plus technical coordinates
taste.decision: Choose the remembered sentence as the reading anchor over equal field weight
taste.reason: The subject is why a song remains attached to a moment, not the database row
evidence: date, place and controls use smaller supporting type

taste.name: A narrow measure creates attention
taste.trigger: When a personal statement must hold focus beside a visual object
taste.decision: Choose an approximately 430px text measure over the full hero-column width
taste.reason: Shorter lines join the display statement and body copy into one editorial unit

taste.name: One dominant sentence
taste.trigger: When a hero contains explanation and a product preview
taste.decision: Choose one 95px serif statement over several equally prominent headings
taste.reason: The structure remains legible when blurred

taste.name: Product-specific restraint boundary
taste.trigger: When applying the reference to an archival site rather than a waitlist landing page
taste.decision: Transfer memory hierarchy and reading width while rejecting the orange accent, floating tiles, shadows and phone composition
taste.reason: The established archive identity is flat paper with six distinct modules
evidence: reference uses #FF6500 and rounded memory tiles
repository contract uses deep red, square edges and no shadow by default
